chunks: Everything in Hā that is from Idris ibn Zayd and Ali ibn Idris, the two companions of al-Riḍā عليه السلام, I have narrated from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī Mājīlawayh — may Allah be pleased with him — from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, from his father, from Idris ibn Zayd and Ali ibn Idris, from al-Riḍā عليه السلام.

key_terms.صَاحِبَيِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: the two companions of Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Idris ibn Zayd and Ali ibn Idris in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad for reports in the book transmitted from Idris ibn Zayd and Ali ibn Idris from Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام. It serves as a chain-reference note identifying the author’s route of transmission rather than conveying a substantive legal or theological teaching.
